pytest_source_binding: pyproject.toml pythonpath=[src], explicit -c pyproject.toml for external cases

corrected.command: uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests/integration/p2 tests/integration/p1/test_core.py tests/integration/p1/test_notes.py /workspace/evidence/p2-review/test_adversarial.py -q --junitxml=/workspace/evidence/p2-review/corrected-production-p1-external.xml

final.command: uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests/integration/p2 tests/integration/p1/test_core.py tests/integration/p1/test_notes.py tests/integration/p1/test_intrinsic_provenance.py tests/integration/p1/test_disposition.py tests/packaging/test_p2_distribution.py /workspace/evidence/p2-review/test_adversarial.py -q --junitxml=/workspace/evidence/p2-review/final-p2-shared-external.xml

final_integrity.command: uv run --no-sync python -m pytest tests/integration/p2 tests/integration/p1/test_core.py tests/integration/p1/test_notes.py tests/integration/p1/test_intrinsic_provenance.py tests/integration/p1/test_disposition.py tests/packaging/test_p2_distribution.py /workspace/evidence/p2-review/test_adversarial.py -q --junitxml=/workspace/evidence/p2-review/final-integrity-p2.xml
